description.en: Planned fossil internal-shell study with a long curved posterior prong and expanded anterior plate.
description.zh: 拟议化石内壳研究：后部具长弯刺，前部为扩展薄板。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning concept with a named morphological source; inferred anatomy and artistic simplification are separate from observed fossil form.
scientific_scope.zh: 具有具名形态来源的属级规划方案；推断解剖和美术简化须与化石可见形态分开。

distinctness.en: A pronged internal shell has a different construction from exposed chambered external shells and complete coleoid bodies.
distinctness.zh: 带弯刺内壳的结构区别于外露有室壳及完整鞘亚纲动物体形。

modeling_brief.en: Block the thick rear mass and curved prong first, then add a thin expanded front plate. Retain a readable thickness hierarchy while omitting microscopic shell chambers.
modeling_brief.zh: 先搭建较厚后部与弯刺，再添加前方扩展薄板；保留清楚厚薄层次，省略微小壳室。

uncertainty: Endoskeleton only: soft-body proportions are not established.
reference_notes: Period is representative, not a full range or a coexistence statement. Endoskeleton only: soft-body proportions are not established.

sources.title: Functional morphology of the Eocene coleoid Belosepia
sources.supports: Belosaepiid endoskeleton curved posterior prong and large anterior proostracum; name spelling differs from accepted Belosaepia.

sources.title: The Middle Eocene Belosaepia ungula from Texas: structure, ontogeny and function
sources.supports: Belosaepia ungula shell material, Eocene Crockett Formation Texas; no complete soft-body anatomy implied.
